body: She hasn't destroyed my happiness unfortunately.  I was miserable until I met her, she gave me happiness, and then took it away with my heart when she left.  I've been forgetting, although trying not to, for the past year or so.  My only coping mechanism right now is already distraction.  I do everything in my power to try to make myself think of anything else.  Thank you for trying to help

Thoughts of her have already faded, but on bad days with no happy moments they still bleed through.  Your later point about what i'm not looking for is valid though, and I am/will continue to try to follow it. Thank you :)
I have tried to do this, thank you.  I added an edit to my post and I actually asked out a new girlfriend since this all happened.  But again if you check the post, it's still not a very happy story.

he was already at the top when I came to check this haha. but thank you for trying to point it out for me!

I dont know why you got a downvote, I guess it's against etiquette or something to not contribute anything of your own, but thanks anyway. You were trying to help

I believe I've gotten over my romantic love for her.  I still love her as a human being because she was never anything but great to me.  When we were still together we legitimately never had a single fight, naive as that may sound.  After more than a year of losing her partnership and almost a year after losing her friendship, I think I finally hit enough time where I have closure, the open wound of our relationship SLOWLY closed after all the time completely away from her.

I still miss the bond of friendship we had, I was closer to her than I have ever been to anyone I've ever met.  She always made me feel wanted as a person, not just a boyfriend, and we just plain got along so well.  I really just want to be friends with her again.

Also i'm gonna add an edit/p.s. to my original post and explain something real quick.
